molecular_consequence: Constitutive GTPase activation, impaired GTP hydrolysis locking KRAS in active state
clinical_significance: Predictive of Response / Sensitivity
resistance_association: Secondary KRAS mutations (Y96D, G12V), MET amplification, or bypass RTK activation
contraindications_or_limitations: Indicated specifically in locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC harboring KRAS G12C who have received at least one prior systemic therapy.

molecular_consequence: Impaired GTPase catalytic activity, persistent MAPK/ERK and PI3K pathway activation
clinical_significance: Pathogenic / Negative Predictive for EGFR Antibodies / Investigational Target
potential_treatment: Investigational KRAS G12D selective inhibitors (e.g., MRTX1133), Standard FOLFIRINOX/Gemcitabine+Nab-Paclitaxel
resistance_association: Conveys primary resistance to anti-EGFR monoclonal antibodies (Cetuximab, Panitumumab) in colorectal cancer
contraindications_or_limitations: Anti-EGFR therapy contraindicated in colorectal cancer with KRAS exon 2/3/4 mutations. G12D inhibitors remain investigational in clinical trials.

molecular_consequence: Steric hindrance of GTPase-activating proteins, hyperactive downstream signaling
clinical_significance: Pathogenic / Resistance to anti-EGFR antibodies
resistance_association: Conveys therapeutic resistance to Cetuximab and Panitumumab
contraindications_or_limitations: Do not treat with Cetuximab/Panitumumab in mCRC.

molecular_consequence: Destabilization of EGFR auto-inhibited kinase conformation, increased ATP affinity
clinical_significance: Predictive of Sensitivity to EGFR TKIs
resistance_association: Acquired EGFR T790M (for 1st/2nd gen TKIs) or C797S (for Osimertinib), MET amplification
contraindications_or_limitations: First-line Osimertinib is standard of care. Baseline monitoring of cardiac function (QTc, LVEF) and interstitial lung disease required.

molecular_consequence: Gatekeeper residue mutation increasing ATP binding affinity, sterically hindering 1st-gen TKIs
clinical_significance: Predictive of Response to 3rd-Gen TKI / Resistance to 1st-Gen TKI
resistance_association: Causes resistance to Gefitinib and Erlotinib; tertiary resistance emerges via C797S
contraindications_or_limitations: Only indicated when T790M status is confirmed post-progression on prior EGFR TKI or as detected.

cancer_context: Melanoma / Colorectal Cancer / Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
molecular_consequence: Monomeric active conformation mimicry, 500-fold kinase activity elevation
clinical_significance: Predictive of Sensitivity to Combined BRAF+MEK Inhibition
resistance_association: BRAF amplification, MEK1/2 mutations, NRAS mutations
contraindications_or_limitations: Single-agent BRAF inhibition is ineffective in colorectal cancer due to rapid feedback EGFR activation; must be paired with anti-EGFR.

molecular_consequence: Kinase domain hot-spot mutation, constitutive lipid kinase activation inducing AKT phosphorylation
clinical_significance: Predictive of Sensitivity to PI3Kα Inhibitors
evidence_level: Level A (FDA-Approved in HR+/HER2- Breast Cancer)
resistance_association: PTEN loss, ESR1 mutations, FGFR1 amplification
contraindications_or_limitations: Contraindicated in patients with severe uncontrolled hyperglycemia (Type 1 diabetes or high HbA1c). Monitor glucose rigorously.

molecular_consequence: Helical domain mutation disrupting inhibitory interaction with p85 regulatory subunit
clinical_significance: Predictive of Response to Alpelisib
resistance_association: Loss of PTEN, AKT hyperactivation
contraindications_or_limitations: Strict glucose and dermatologic toxicity monitoring required.

molecular_consequence: Loss of LKB1 kinase, hyperactivation of mTORC1, loss of AMPK energy-sensing, STING repression
evidence_source: CIViC / ESMO Open / Clinical Cancer Research
clinical_significance: Negative Predictive Biomarker for Single-Agent Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors (PD-1/PD-L1)
potential_treatment: Chemotherapy doublet combinations, Investigational metabolic/mTOR combinations
resistance_association: Associated with an immunologically 'cold' tumor microenvironment and reduced efficacy of anti-PD-1 monotherapy
contraindications_or_limitations: Patients with co-occurring KRAS and STK11 mutations derive significantly less benefit from pembrolizumab monotherapy than KRAS-mutant/STK11-wildtype tumors.

molecular_consequence: Impaired NRF2 ubiquitination leading to persistent oxidative stress response and drug efflux
clinical_significance: Negative Prognostic Marker / Reduced Immunotherapy Efficacy
potential_treatment: Investigational glutaminase inhibitors, Chemotherapy with anti-CTLA4/PD-1 combinations
resistance_association: Associated with chemotherapy and immunotherapy resistance
contraindications_or_limitations: Frequent co-occurrence with STK11 and KRAS in aggressive LUAD subsets.

molecular_consequence: Inactivation of TGF-beta tumor suppressor signaling cascade, accelerated metastatic dissemination
clinical_significance: Poor Prognostic Biomarker / Highly Specific for Advanced Pancreatic Biology
resistance_association: Associated with aggressive systemic progression and early metastatic recurrence
contraindications_or_limitations: Loss of SMAD4 is observed in ~50% of advanced pancreatic tumors and indicates high metastatic potential.

molecular_consequence: Loss of p16INK4a tumor suppressor, loss of CDK4/6 inhibition, deregulation of G1/S checkpoint
clinical_significance: Pathogenic / Candidate for CDK4/6 Inhibitor Studies
potential_treatment: CDK4/6 inhibitors (Palbociclib, Abemaciclib in clinical trial settings)
resistance_association: Associated with cell cycle checkpoint deregulation
contraindications_or_limitations: Not yet standard first-line indication outside breast cancer without clinical trial protocol.

molecular_consequence: Loss of beta-catenin destruction complex binding, nuclear beta-catenin accumulation, Wnt pathway hyperactivation
clinical_significance: Diagnostic / Pathogenic Hall-Mark of Colorectal Carcinogenesis
evidence_level: Level A (Defining Genomic Event in Colorectal Cancer)
potential_treatment: Standard fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy, Investigational Wnt pathway antagonists
resistance_association: None direct for standard chemo, but essential tumor-initiating gatekeeper
contraindications_or_limitations: Observed in >70% of colorectal carcinomas. Does not confer sensitivity to EGFR or HER2 agents on its own.

cancer_context: Breast Invasive Carcinoma / Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
molecular_consequence: Activating mutation in the ERBB2 kinase domain, constitutive tyrosine autophosphorylation
clinical_significance: Predictive of Response to HER2-Targeted Agents
evidence_level: Level A (FDA-Approved / Validated in Clinical Trials)
resistance_association: Secondary ERBB2 kinase mutations, PI3K pathway alterations
contraindications_or_limitations: Requires cardiac monitoring (LVEF) and vigilance for drug-induced interstitial lung disease.

molecular_consequence: Disruption of RING finger domain, loss of BARD1 binding and E3 ubiquitin ligase activity, homologous recombination deficiency (HRD)
clinical_significance: Predictive of Synthetic Lethality to PARP Inhibitors and Platinum Agents
resistance_association: Secondary BRCA reversion mutations restoring open reading frame
contraindications_or_limitations: Monitor for secondary myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) and acute myeloid leukemia (AML).

molecular_consequence: Premature truncation in RAD51-binding carboxyl-terminus, impaired double-strand break repair
clinical_significance: Pathogenic / Sensitivity to PARP Inhibitors and Platinum-based Therapies
evidence_level: Level A (FDA-Approved in Germline/Somatic HRD Malignancies)
potential_treatment: Olaparib, Talazoparib, Platinum chemotherapy (Cisplatin, Carboplatin, Oxaliplatin)
resistance_association: Secondary reversion mutations restoring open reading frame
contraindications_or_limitations: Ensure assessment of germline vs somatic status to guide family genetic counseling.

molecular_consequence: Structural conformational mutant destroying zinc coordination in DNA binding domain; gain of oncogenic function
clinical_significance: Pathogenic / Adverse Prognostic Factor / Cell Cycle Deregulation
potential_treatment: Investigational p53 reactivation compounds (e.g. APR-246/Eprenetapopt), ATR/WEE1 inhibitors
resistance_association: Associated with relative chemoresistance and genomic instability
contraindications_or_limitations: Present across ~50% of human malignancies. Not an isolated target for approved single-agent therapies currently.

molecular_consequence: DNA-contact hot-spot mutation directly abolishing major groove contact with target gene promoters
clinical_significance: Pathogenic / Negative Prognostic Biomarker
potential_treatment: Investigational targeted agents, Standard disease-specific systemic regimens
resistance_association: Attenuates apoptosis induction in response to DNA damage
contraindications_or_limitations: Requires clinical context; somatic mutation indicates aggressive tumor biology.

molecular_consequence: Inactivation of lipid phosphatase active site, unrestrained PIP3 accumulation and AKT/mTOR activation
clinical_significance: Pathogenic / Biomarker of PI3K Pathway Hyperactivation
resistance_association: Associated with primary resistance to PI3Kα-selective inhibitors (Alpelisib)
contraindications_or_limitations: In HR+ breast cancer, PTEN loss can confer intrinsic resistance to PI3Kα inhibitors.

molecular_consequence: Loss of E-cadherin adhesion glycoprotein, dyscohesive tumor cell infiltration
clinical_significance: Pathogenic / Characteristic of Lobular Histology
potential_treatment: Systemic endocrine therapy (Aromatase inhibitors / Fulvestrant) in ER+ disease
resistance_association: Dyscohesive growth pattern with predilection for peritoneal/retroperitoneal metastases
contraindications_or_limitations: High frequency in Invasive Lobular Carcinoma (ILC); standard imaging can underestimate extent.
